relevance.reason: Gemini desktop app for Windows makes AI assistant accessible to everyday users on desktop - practical tool people can use

title: The Gemini desktop app is now available for Windows
author: Paul Jiménez Vela
content_snippet:
Today, we’re launching the Gemini desktop app for Windows 10 and 11. This new application is designed to operate seamlessly alongside users’ favorite tools, providing instant assistance without disrupting their workflows.
The Gemini app for Windows provides users with a variety of ways to enhance their productivity directly from their desktop:


The Alt + Space keyboard shortcut brings Gemini over active work for quick tasks, like fact-checking a document or brainstorming presentation titles.
Users can ask Gemini to draft project summaries using information pulled directly from Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Drive.
Users can bring creative concepts to life by generating custom images with Nano Banana directly from their desktop.


This launch marks the beginning of Gemini app’s native desktop capabilities for Windows, with more features planned to roll out over time.



Getting started


Admins: This feature is ON by default for all organizations with Gemini enabled. The Gemini app and related in-app tools are controlled by the Generative AI settings in the Workspace Admin console. This feature is subject to these existing controls. Visit the Help Center for more information on turning the Gemini app on or off.
End users: There is no end user setting for this feature. Download the Google Gemini app today at gemini.google/desktop. Visit the Help Center to learn more.


Rollout pace


Rapid Release and Scheduled Release domains: Available now


Availability


Available to all Google Workspace customers, Workspace Individual subscribers, and users with personal Google accounts


Resources


News from Google: The Gemini app for Windows is here
Google Workspace Admin Help: Turn the Gemini app on or off
Gemini Apps Help: Gemini app for Windows
